title: Frozen Pre-Execution Prediction for Increment-85 C3->C4 Holdout Validation
governance_note: Prediction coefficients and uncertainty intervals derived solely from previously available Packages 111-118 calibration data. No holdout results used for calibration.

predictive_model.formulation: Localized AT2 Phase-Field Discretization Sharpening Model
predictive_model.calibration_basis: Decomposed quadrature (-0.1217%) and variational crack-tip sharpening (+9.4339%) from Packages 111-118

uncertainty_interval.extrapolation_uncertainty_note: Uncertainty band reflects ±0.20% potential variation due to accelerated crack localization as d_max increases towards 0.50.

residual_sign_convention.r_E_positive: Excess target energy beyond predicted discretization sharpening (spurious hardening/ratcheting)
residual_sign_convention.r_E_negative: Target energy deficit below predicted discretization sharpening (spurious dissipation/healing)
residual_sign_convention.r_E_zero: Exact balance between target energy and independently predicted mesh-sharpened energy

falsification_condition.falsification_rule: |r_E| > 0.50% falsifies the localized AT2 scaling model

governance_status.role_of_holdout: Prospective diagnostic verification only; does not retroactively alter Package 113 gate status
